policy: npm audit at level high must pass. A high or critical advisory may be listed here only when its fix is younger than the repository's 14-day minimum package age and the affected package is development-only (not in the production dependency tree; scripts/audit-gate.mjs checks package-lock.json). Each entry names the advisory and the package (both must match), the date it was added, and an expiry at most 30 days later, which forces the upgrade. docs/DEPENDENCIES.md records each entry.
